+---
+name: docgen
+description: >-
+  Generate and preview PHP documentation with the DocGen CLI (k-kinzal/docgen-php).
+  Use for docgen commands, package selection, public API sites, revision diffs,
+  coverage and architecture inputs, caching, or documentation jobs in GitHub Actions.
+---
+
+# DocGen
+
+Run the installed CLI from the target project's root. Read its `composer.json`
+autoload maps and existing documentation command to preserve the intended scope.
+Use the project's `composer docgen` script when present; otherwise invoke the CLI:
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/docgen --help
+vendor/bin/docgen
+vendor/bin/docgen --serve
+```
+
+The default run documents `.` and `packages/*` into `build/docs`. Preview serves
+the generated site at `127.0.0.1:8090` until interrupted.
+
+## Command rules
+
+- DocGen has no configuration file; pass settings as CLI options.
+- `--packages` selects directories with a `composer.json`. Production PSR-4
+  sources get API pages; `autoload-dev` sources get linkable source pages only.
+- Quote globs. Explicit `--packages` replaces the defaults; repeated glob options
+  append values. `--vendor` and `--vendor-dev` select Composer package names,
+  such as `'acme/*'`, and are opt-in.
+- Keep the cache (`build/docgen-cache` by default) outside the published output.
+- `--public-api` selects declarations tagged `@visibility public`; it still
+  includes whole source files and Markdown documents, so it does not redact them.
+
+After generation, check the reported package count, `index.html`, and a relevant
+symbol or source page. Exit `2` means an invalid command, input, or runtime error;
+read the `DocGen error:` message before retrying.
+
+## References
+
+Read only the material needed for the current task:
+
+- [CLI options](references/cli.md): option values, defaults, exit codes, and troubleshooting.
+- [Use cases](references/use-cases.md): monorepos, dependencies, public API, coverage,
+  architecture, revision comparisons, caching, and reusable Composer commands.
+- [GitHub Actions](references/github-actions.md): generation, cache reuse, Pages
+  publishing, and pull-request previews using [docs.yml](assets/docs.yml) and
+  [docs-preview.yml](assets/docs-preview.yml).

+# CLI options
+
+Run `vendor/bin/docgen --help` for the installed version. Values accept either
+`--option=value` or `--option value`. Glob options accept comma-separated lists
+and repeated occurrences; quote them to prevent shell expansion.
+
+## Scope and output
+
+| Option | Default | Meaning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `--packages=GLOBS` | `.,packages/*` | Directory globs, relative to the working directory; each matching `composer.json` defines a package. Explicit values replace the defaults. |
+| `--exclude=GLOBS` | none | Paths relative to the project root to omit from source and Markdown discovery. |
+| `--vendor[=GLOBS]` | none | Installed runtime dependencies selected by Composer package name; bare `--vendor` selects all. |
+| `--vendor-dev[=GLOBS]` | none | Installed dev dependencies selected by Composer package name; bare `--vendor-dev` selects all. |
+| `--public-api` | off | Select top-level declarations tagged `@visibility public`. |
+| `--output=DIR`, `-o DIR` | `build/docs` | Generated site directory. |
+| `--title=TEXT` | root package name, else project directory name | Site title. |
+| `--deptrac=FILE` | `deptrac.yaml` when present | Layer definitions and ruleset for architecture graphs and badges. |
+| `--coverage=DIR` | none | PHPUnit `--coverage-xml` directory for method-to-test references. |
+| `--base-url=URL` | none | Published absolute HTTP(S) URL for canonical links and social metadata. |
+| `--repository=URL` | manifest `support.source`, then `homepage` | Absolute HTTP(S) URL overriding repository links for project packages. |
+
+Package PSR-4 maps determine the source scope. Dependencies remain excluded unless
+selected, even when their types occur in public signatures. Vendor globs match
+names such as `'acme/*'`, not directory paths such as `vendor/acme`.
+
+## Comparison and execution
+
+| Option | Default | Meaning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `--diff=BASE` | off | Compare BASE with the working tree, including uncommitted changes. |
+| `--diff=BASE..HEAD` | off | Compare two Git revisions. |
+| `--base=REVISION` | none | Set or override the base revision. |
+| `--head=REVISION` | working tree | Set or override the head; requires a base from `--base` or `--diff`. |
+| `--serve[=HOST:PORT]` | off; bare flag uses `127.0.0.1:8090` | Generate, then serve until interrupted. A bare port also works. |
+| `--cache-dir=DIR` | `build/docgen-cache` | Parse and page cache directory; keep outside output. |
+| `--no-cache` | off | Parse and render everything without reading or writing the cache. |
+| `--clear-cache` | off | Remove the cache before generating. |
+| `--jobs=N`, `-j N` | CPU cores minus one, at least 1 and at most 16 | Worker count; `1` runs sequentially. |
+| `--memory-limit=VALUE` | environment limit, raised to at least `512M` | Override with a byte count, `512M`, `1G`, or `-1` for unlimited. |
+
+`--quiet` keeps errors and warnings, `--no-ansi` disables color, and `--version`
+prints the version. Progress goes to stdout; warnings and errors go to stderr.
+
+## Exit codes and troubleshooting
+
+| Code | Meaning | Next step |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `0` | Generation succeeded. | Inspect output and any warnings. |
+| `1` | Bootstrap failed: unsupported PHP or missing Composer autoloader. | Use PHP 8.0 or later and the project's installed dependencies. |
+| `2` | Invalid command, input, or runtime failure. | Follow the error message; use `--help` for option syntax. |
+
+- Missing packages: check the working directory, `--packages`, and PSR-4 maps.
+  An unmatched vendor glob or a PHAR-only dependency emits a warning.
+- Missing methods' test references: pass a PHPUnit XML coverage directory, not
+  Clover XML or an HTML report.
+- Sequential execution: workers require `pcntl` and CLI OPcache/JIT to be off.
+  Sequential fallback produces the same site.
+- Stale pages after editing DocGen itself: use `--clear-cache` or `--no-cache`;
+  local generator edits do not change its installed-version cache fingerprint.
+- Missing social image: generation needs `--base-url` and GD with FreeType.
+  Without GD, generation continues without `assets/og-image.png`.

+# Use cases
+
+Run examples from the project root and adapt paths to its manifests. When reusing
+an existing Composer script, inspect its options first: adding `--packages` to a
+script that already sets it widens the selection rather than replacing it.
+
+## Select packages and dependencies
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/docgen --packages=packages/billing --output=build/billing-docs
+vendor/bin/docgen --packages='.,packages/*' --exclude='*/tests/Fixture/*'
+vendor/bin/docgen --vendor='acme/*' --vendor-dev='phpunit/*'
+```
+
+Single-package projects need no `--packages` option. In a monorepo, explicitly
+select the intended package if sibling packages should be absent. Keep normal and
+diff runs in the same working directory with the same scope and input paths.
+After narrowing the scope, check the package list and that old pages disappear
+from the cached output.
+
+Use dependency flags only when dependency documentation is wanted. Unmatched
+package-name globs and packages without autoloadable PHP sources emit warnings.
+
+## Generate a public API site
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/docgen --public-api --output=build/public-docs
+```
+
+Only top-level declarations carrying `@visibility public` get API pages. Their
+public and protected members remain unless a member narrows its own visibility;
+private members, test references, call sites, and relation indexes are omitted.
+Untagged declarations are absent even when PHP makes them accessible.
+
+Source pages still show entire files containing selected declarations. README and
+Markdown pages also remain. Review those inputs before using this mode for a
+public site. Diff mode applies the selection to both revisions.
+
+## Include coverage, architecture, and examples
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml
+vendor/bin/docgen --coverage=build/coverage-xml --deptrac=deptrac.yaml
+```
+
+Prefer the project's existing coverage command when it selects a PHPUnit version
+or configuration. Coverage requires PCOV or Xdebug. DocGen consumes the report;
+it does not run tests. Root `deptrac.yaml` is discovered automatically, so specify
+`--deptrac` only for another path.
+
+PHPDoc `@example` blocks and PHP fences using doctest assertions (`// =>`,
+`// Output:`, `// throws`) appear as examples without an extra CLI option. Their
+run buttons provide PHPUnit commands; generating the site does not execute them.
+
+## Compare revisions
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/docgen --diff=main --output=build/docs-diff
+vendor/bin/docgen --diff=v1.0.0..HEAD --output=build/docs-diff
+vendor/bin/docgen --base=main --head=feature --serve
+```
+
+Replace example revisions with existing refs. A single base compares against the
+working tree; a range compares committed revisions. Git must be available and the
+refs must exist locally. DocGen uses temporary worktrees and analyzes both sides.
+In CI, fetch the required history before generation.
+
+Keep packages, exclusions, public API selection, and other content options the
+same as the ordinary site. Coverage applies only to the head side and must match
+that revision. Inspect the generated Off, Diff, and Changes views, including a
+removed declaration when present.
+
+## Reuse caches and control resources
+
+```bash
+vendor/bin/docgen --cache-dir=build/docgen-cache
+vendor/bin/docgen --no-cache --output=build/docs-fresh
+vendor/bin/docgen --clear-cache --jobs=4 --memory-limit=1G
+```
+
+Runs are incremental by default and report reused sources and pages. Use
+`--no-cache` when checking a full rebuild, or `--clear-cache` to discard saved
+state. Choose workers and memory for the machine; many vendor packages may need
+more than the automatic `512M` floor. Keep cache and output as ignored build
+artifacts.
+
+## Reuse a command with Composer
+
+When a reusable project command is requested, keep shared options in one script
+and pass run-specific values through Composer:
+
+```json
+{
+  "scripts": {
+    "docgen": "docgen --exclude='tests/Fixture/*'",
+    "docgen:serve": "@docgen --serve"
+  }
+}
+```
+
+```bash
+composer docgen -- --base-url=https://example.github.io/project
+composer docgen -- --diff=main --output=build/docs-diff
+```
+
+Reuse existing scripts and their scope. Documentation generation is separate from
+`lint`; coverage is an input to generate first when the command requires it.

+# GitHub Actions
+
+Use the same DocGen command and content options locally and in CI. Keep generation
+and publishing in documentation workflows separate from the test/lint workflow.
+
+## Generate and retain the site
+
+After the project's normal PHP and dependency steps, run its existing coverage
+and documentation commands. For a project without those scripts, the equivalent
+generation steps are:
+
+```yaml
+- name: Generate coverage
+  run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml
+- name: Generate documentation
+  run: >-
+    vendor/bin/docgen --coverage=build/coverage-xml
+    --base-url=https://example.github.io/project
+```
+
+Adapt the PHPUnit command and URL to the project. For a site without coverage,
+omit both the coverage step and `--coverage`.
+
+- Restore `build/docgen-cache` with `actions/cache`, using the runner OS, selected
+  Composer lock hash, and commit for the key; use the OS/lock prefix for fallback.
+  Keep the cache outside the uploaded site.
+- Upload the directory passed to `--output` (`build/docs` by default). With
+  `actions/upload-artifact`, include hidden files so `.nojekyll` is retained and
+  fail if the directory is empty.
+- Pass the actual published address through `--base-url`, including a project
+  or preview path when applicable. For a custom domain or an owner site, adapt
+  the URL instead of using the project-site formula in the templates.
+
+## Pages workflow templates
+
+The skill bundles two templates under `assets/`:
+
+| Template | Use |
+| --- | --- |
+| [docs.yml](../assets/docs.yml) | Build on default-branch pushes, upload the site, and publish it to the root of a Pages branch. |
+| [docs-preview.yml](../assets/docs-preview.yml) | Generate pull-request diffs under `pr/<number>/`, comment the URL, and remove previews on close. Requires the root-site workflow. |
+
+Use the templates for requested branch-based Pages publishing. An existing Pages
+deployment can instead consume the generated directory through its own workflow.
+Local generation or artifact-only CI does not require publishing.
+
+Before using a template as `.github/workflows/docs.yml` or `docs-preview.yml`,
+replace every `REPLACE_WITH_*` value with facts from the target project:
+
+| Placeholder | Value to derive |
+| --- | --- |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_DEFAULT_BRANCH` | Repository's default branch. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_DOCS_BRANCH` | Existing branch served by Pages, commonly `gh-pages`. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_DOCGEN_JOB_PHP` | A supported PHP version compatible with DocGen and the project's dependency graph. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS` | Project requirements; GD with FreeType for social images, `pcntl` for workers. The templates select PCOV for coverage. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_DEPENDENCY_MODE` | Existing CI install policy; `locked` when installing the committed lock. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_LOCK_REQUIREMENT` | `true` when a committed lock is required, otherwise the project's lock policy. |
+| `REPLACE_WITH_SELECTED_LOCK_FILE` | Lock file installed by this job and hashed for the cache key. |
+
+For versioned locks, copy the selected lock to `composer.lock` before validation
+and installation. Reuse project coverage and DocGen scripts in both templates;
+retain `composer check-platform-reqs`. Keep action pins as full commit SHAs.
+
+The root template builds with read permissions and publishes in a separate job
+with `contents: write` and `pages: write`. Publishing preserves `pr/` and `CNAME`
+while deleting stale root output. It requests a Pages build and waits for the
+published commit. The Pages branch and repository Pages source must already
+exist; generating HTML alone does not configure hosting.
+
+## Pull-request diffs
+
+The preview template fetches full history and passes the base SHA through an
+environment variable to `--diff`. Its working tree is the pull-request checkout;
+the URL ends in `/pr/<number>`. Keep normal and preview package selection,
+exclusions, coverage, architecture input, and public API mode aligned.
+
+The preview job writes to the docs branch and comments on the pull request. It
+uses `pull_request` and skips forks; retain those restrictions. The root workflow
+owns root output and the preview workflow owns `pr/`. In monorepos, derive all
+paths from the same working directory and include relevant manifests, locks, and
+workflow files in any path filters.
+
+## Verify
+
+Run the generation command locally and inspect the package list and output.
+After adapting a workflow, run `actionlint` and check that no placeholders remain.
+Publication is verified by the workflow run and the served URL, including a
+symbol page and a source link; successful local generation verifies only the build.
